comparison.objective: Twist an ice tray and pour released cubes into a dish; candidate separates media from washers through a screen.
comparison.physical_skill: Opposing torque followed by bulk tipping versus selective, orientation-dependent sifting with bridge clearing.
comparison.success_condition: All eight cubes transferred and tray replaced versus media passing while every washer remains retained and no material spills.
comparison.reason: Bulk emptying shares pouring, but does not test selective passage, retention, or controlled agitation.
